evidence_cards.content: The main flow for creating a compressed archive includes: Creating archives in any of the supported archiving and compression formats; Updating an already existing archive; Appending timestamp with date and time on the managed archive name for archiving and backup purpose; Two factor (password and keyfile) authentication for the managed files and archives; Extracting contents of any compressed file in any of the supported formats; Secure file and archive deletion from any storing unit; Byte to byte comparison between two files; Check files for duplicates or corruption; Splitting files and merging split volumes back to original file; Viewing information list including content, modification dates, space occupation, and object sizes; Viewing file/archive content as hexadecimal values; Graphical monitoring of all executed functions.
